meta.title: Shortening a live window below the current time closes the event cleanly
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open an existing live event with a submitted bid, as required by the setup.
Set the live event's end time to one minute from now.
Wait for the shortened bidding window to pass naturally.
Open the events list to verify the event's resulting state.
Switch to History, where the closed event should appear.
Assert that the event is recorded as closed.
Return to the event page to inspect its retained bid and awarding eligibility.
Assert that the submitted bid remains listed as the event's response.
Open the comparison grid used for post-close awarding and verify the bid is available there.
Enter the awarding flow to verify the retained bid is awardable.
Allocate the available bid to a vendor.
Assert that the bid was successfully allocated for award.
